evidence_method: Official calculator operated through CUA browser UI. Four input cases calculated together. Selected JLC04161H-7628 result checked in accessibility tree and visible screenshot. Results manually transcribed, not an API export.
screenshots: Viewed in tool session; no local screenshot file was saved or claimed.
interpretation: Under the official calculator nominal cross-section and its monotonic width-versus-impedance relation, both existing main trace widths fall inside widths computed at the +/-10% target endpoints. This closes the r9 missing nominal width-window check and does not motivate a width change solely for that check.
not_obtained: Exact forward/inverse official impedance for W=.35 or W/S=.26/.15
limits: Official target solver tolerance +/-0.5% is distinct from manufactured impedance tolerance.
The pair spacing was entered as .1500 mm and displayed by the result as .1501 mm; preserve this rounding/conversion detail.
Non-coplanar nominal cross-section does not evaluate pad escapes, branch stubs, vias, local plane clearance, coupling to nearby copper, or the full routed board.
This result uses the calculator default mask treatment; actual mask/material/copper/etch tolerances still need factory review.
L4/L3 follows the symmetric nominal stackup by inference only, not separate calculation.
No width deviation percentage was relabeled as impedance error.
recommendation: Keep r8 signal main widths for the current local ground-via/DFM remediation; preserve USB pair spacing and reference plane. Carry 90 ohm differential and 50 ohm single-ended targets into the eventual fabrication review.
